test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Shed light on
solution:
The correct answer is 'To explain a situation'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Shed light on is an idiom that means to **help to explain (something) by providing further information about it.**

 
 
• ​Example - *No one could **shed any light on** the mysterious car accident.*
 
 
 
• So, to explain a situation is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
